summary: EShallgo Inc filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 183,862 Class A ordinary shares at $3.25 each and pre-funded warrants at $3.24 each (exercise price $0.01) for up to 271,106 shares, raising approximately $1.48M. The placement agent is Univest Securities. The filing is a routine capital raise under Rule 424(b)(5) with no special-situation trigger; it is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a transformational event. No board recommendation or strategic review is mentioned. The structure includes a typical 7% placement agent fee.
